This petition is filed u/s.166 of M.V.Act 1989 for claiming compensation of Rs.30,00,000/- on account of death of Manchamma W/o Late Huchegowda.

2. It is the case of the petitioners that on 01-10-2024 at about 7-30 a.m., within the jurisdiction of Kodihalli Police Station, in front of house of Chikkaswamy, Igollahalli - Hookunda road when the deceased pedestrian Smt. Manchamma was walking in the side of the road, at that time the accused drove the offending Mahindra Bolero Goods vehicle bearing Reg. No.KA-42- B-7051 in a rash or negligent manner so as to endanger human life and dashed against the deceased, as a result the the deceased fell down sustained grievous bleeding injuries on her hand and leg.

Thereafter she was shifted Government Hospital, Kanakapura for first aid and for higher treatment she was shifted to Dr.Chandramma Dayananda Sagar Hospital of Harohalli and due to efficacious of treatment at 11.34 a.m., she was died due to injuries sustained in the alleged accident.

It seems that Pw.1 has clearly made those versions, which could not be 15 SCCH - 7 MVC.No.7708/2024 shattered in cross examination.

Therefore, considering the above discussed aspects collectively, it is the considered opinion of the Court that, the incident having been taken place in the manner asserted by the prosecution and the same being proved to have been taken place in the manner alleged by the prosecution, the accused drew the offending vehicle in a high speed, rash or negligent manner so as to endanger human life and at the spot dashed against the unoffending vehicle as a result the deceased Manchamma sustained grievous injury and died due to alleged accident.

The evidence of Pw.1, Ex.P-1/FIR, Ex.P-2/Complaint, Ex.P3/spot Mahazar, Ex.P4/spot sketch, Ex.P-5/IMV Report,
Ex.P-6/Inquest, Ex.P-16/Postmortem Report and Ex.P-7/Charge Sheet clearly establishes that the alleged accident occurred at the spot.
It is not in dispute as to the aspect that, the deceased Manchamma sustained grievous injuries and died in the alleged incident.
Because, for the above reasons collectively, it is clear that, the accident happened due to rash or negligent act of the accused.
It is evident that injuries and cause of death of deceased Manchamma noted in the Ex.P16/PM report would be caused by a road accident.
At the same time, it has come out in evidence that the alleged accident was occurred due to rash or 16 SCCH - 7 MVC.No.7708/2024 negligent driving of the offending vehicle and fault of the accused.
Matters being so, the acts of the accused person clearly constitute the offences punishable under sections 281 and 106 of BNS.

Thus because of such negligent act of the accused/driver of the offending vehicle, it resulted in the death of the innocent senior citizen women/Smt.Manchamma aforesaid, as he/accused drove the said offending vehicle very rashly or negligently on the spot.
Therefore, the alleged accident occurred due to the fault of the accused/driver of the offending vehicle.

sentences.text: The petitioners have contended that as on the date of the accident the deceased was aged about 80 years and they relied on the Ex.P-11/Adhar Card of the deceased, wherein the date of birth of the deceased is shown as 01.01.1945 and this accident was taken place on 01.10.2024.
Hence it is clear that as on the date of the accident the deceased was aged about 79 years and 9 months.
Hence the age of the deceased is considered as 79 years.
24. It is not in dispute that the deceased died in the road traffic accident occurred due to rash and negligent riding of the offending vehicle by its driver.
In the instance case the petitioners claimed that deceased was a Homemaker and earning Rs.20,000/- p.m.
But they have not produced any documents to prove the actual 18 SCCH - 7 MVC.No.7708/2024 income of the deceased.
In the absence of proof of income the notional income has to be assessed.
As per the guidelines issued by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority, for the accident taken place in the year 2024, the notional income of the deceased taken at Rs.15,750/-.

As per decision reported in AIR 2017 SC 5157 in the case of National Insurance Co. Ltd., V/s Pranay Sethy deduct 1/4th of the income towards personal and living expenses of the deceased and the remaining amount, i.e., Rs.11,812/-
(Rs.15,750/- - 1/4 = Rs.3,938/-), (Rs.15,750/- - 3,938/- = Rs.11,812/-) has to be taken as her/deceased contribution to the family.

sentences.text: The deceased was aged about 79 years at the time of accident and multiplier applicable to his age group is '5'.
Thus the claimants are entitled to compensation of Rs.7,08,720/- (Rs.11,812/- x 12 x 5) on account of loss of dependency.
25. In addition, the Petitioners are entitled to compensation of Rs.15,000/- on account of Loss of estate and compensation of Rs.15,000/- on account of Funeral expenses.

In view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in 2018 ACJ 2782 in the Case of Magma General Insurance Co.
Ltd., V/s Nanu Ram, Petitioners No.1 to 4 are the children of the deceased are 19 SCCH - 7 MVC.No.7708/2024 entitled for compensation of Rs.40,000/- under the head of loss of filial consortium and also entitled for compensation of Rs.50,000/- each under the head of love and affection.

sentences.text: In view of the Pranay Sethi's case the Hon'ble Apex court in the year 2016 has stated that it would be appropriate to award a sum of Rs.40,000/- towards consortium for dependents and this sum was to be increased by 10% every three years and consequently as of 2024, a sum of Rs.50,664/- is to be paid to each of the dependents towards head of loss of filial consortium, loss of estate and funeral expenses caused by the loss of a deceased.

It cannot be in dispute that the loss of a deceased causes a devastating blow to the dependents and the degree of pain and agony would be at its speak and would linger forever it is for this reason an adequate sum is required to be awarded.
This sum can also be increased every year by adducing the record date of the inflation henceforth.
Accordingly now coming to the matter on hand, the Petitioners are entitled to compensation of Rs.19,000/- on account of Loss of estate and compensation of Rs.19,000/- on account of Funeral expenses.

The Petitioners No.1 to 4 are the children of the deceased are entitled for compensation of Rs.50,664/- each under the head of loss of consortium and also entitled for compensation of Rs.50,000/- each 20 SCCH - 7 MVC.No.7708/2024 under the head of love and affection.

ORDER
The claim petition filed by the Petitioners under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act is hereby Partly allowed with cost.

The Petitioners are entitled for total compensation amount of Rs.11,49,376/- (Rupees Eleven Lakhs Forty Nine Thousand Three Hundred and Seventy Six only) with interest @ 6% p.a., from the date of petition till its realization.
The Insurance Company company/Respondent No.2 is directed to the deposit the compensation amount within two months from the date of this order.
The Petitioners No.1 to 4 are entitled to 1/4th share each in the compensation amount along with interest.

After deposit, entire share of compensation amount with interest allotted to the Petitioners No.1 to 4 shall 22 SCCH - 7 MVC.No.7708/2024 be released in their favour through E- payment with proper verification and identification.
Advocate fee is fixed at Rs.1,000/-.
Draw the award accordingly.

3 :: I S S U E S ::
1.
Whether the Petitioners proves that on 01-10-2024 at about 7.30 a.m the deceased Manchamma was pedestrian in front of Chikkaswamy house, Gollahalli village,
Uyyamballi Hobli, Kanakapura Taluk, Ramanagara Dist at that time driver of offending Mahindra Bolero LGV bearing registration No.KA-42-B-7051 drove the same in a rash and negligent 7 SCCH - 7 MVC.No.7708/2024 manner so as to endanger human life and dashed against deceased from behind.
As a result of which,
the deceased sustained grievous injuries and died on the way to the Hospital?
2. Whether the Petitioners prove that, they are legal heirs of deceased Smt.
Manchamma?
3. Whether petitioners are entitled for compensation?
If so, what is the quantum?
from whom?
4.
What order or award?
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The alleged accident was occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle and fault of the accused.
Therefore, considering the above discussed aspects collectively, it is the considered opinion of the Court that, the incident having been taken place in the manner asserted by the prosecution and the same being proved to have been taken place in the manner alleged by the prosecution, the accused drew the offending vehicle in a high speed, rash or negligent manner so as to endanger human life and at the spot dashed against the unoffending vehicle as a result the deceased Manchamma sustained grievous injury and died due to alleged accident.
It is evident that injuries and cause of death of deceased Manchamma noted in the Ex.P16/PM report would be caused by a road accident.
At the same time, it has come out in evidence that the alleged accident was occurred due to rash or 16 SCCH - 7 MVC.No.7708/2024 negligent driving of the offending vehicle and fault of the accused.
Matters being so, the acts of the accused person clearly constitute the offences punishable under sections 281 and 106 of BNS.
Thus because of such negligent act of the accused/driver of the offending vehicle, it resulted in the death of the innocent senior citizen women/Smt.Manchamma aforesaid, as he/accused drove the said offending vehicle very rashly or negligently on the spot.
Therefore, the alleged accident occurred due to the fault of the accused/driver of the offending vehicle.
The petitioners have contended that as on the date of the accident the deceased was aged about 80 years and they relied on the Ex.P-11/Adhar Card of the deceased, wherein the date of birth of the deceased is shown as 01.01.1945 and this accident was taken place on 01.10.2024.
Hence it is clear that as on the date of the accident the deceased was aged about 79 years and 9 months.
Hence the age of the deceased is considered as 79 years.
In the instance case the petitioners claimed that deceased was a Homemaker and earning Rs.20,000/- p.m.
But they have not produced any documents to prove the actual 18 SCCH - 7 MVC.No.7708/2024 income of the deceased.
In the absence of proof of income the notional income has to be assessed.
As per the guidelines issued by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority, for the accident taken place in the year 2024, the notional income of the deceased taken at Rs.15,750/-.
The deceased was aged about 79 years at the time of accident and multiplier applicable to his age group is '5'.
In view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in 2018 ACJ 2782 in the Case of Magma General Insurance Co.
Ltd., V/s Nanu Ram, Petitioners No.1 to 4 are the children of the deceased are 19 SCCH - 7 MVC.No.7708/2024 entitled for compensation of Rs.40,000/- under the head of loss of filial consortium and also entitled for compensation of Rs.50,000/- each under the head of love and affection.
